parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS envelope
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(envelope->>'action'), ''), 'preview')) AS action,
    COALESCE(envelope->'form_data', '{}'::jsonb) AS form_data,
    COALESCE(envelope->>'creator_message', '') AS creator_message,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(envelope->>'correlation_id'), ''), 'unavailable') AS correlation_id
  FROM input
), resolved AS (
  SELECT n.*, target.node_code,
    CASE WHEN n.action = 'preview' THEN public.rpc_workbench(jsonb_build_object(
      'action', 'read',
      'local_operator_id', n.form_data->>'local_operator_id',
      'node_code', target.node_code
    )) ELSE jsonb_build_object('ok', false) END AS payload
  FROM normalized AS n
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('FP001-03'::text), ('FP001-05'::text)) AS target(node_code)
), config AS (
  SELECT
    max(action) AS action,
    (array_agg(form_data))[1] AS form_data,
    max(creator_message) AS creator_message,
    max(correlation_id) AS correlation_id,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE((payload->>'ok')::boolean, false)
      AND NULLIF(btrim(payload #>> '{effective_config,prompts,0,effective_value,prompt_text}'), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(payload #>> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,effective_value,model_name}'), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(payload #>> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,effective_value,provider_base_url}'), '') IS NOT NULL) = 2 AS config_available,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,prompts,0,effective_value,prompt_text}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-03') AS dialogue_prompt,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,prompts,0,effective_value,prompt_text}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-05') AS commercial_prompt,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,effective_value,model_name}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-03') AS dialogue_model_name,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,effective_value,provider_base_url}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-03') AS dialogue_provider_base_url,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,source_config_id}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-03') AS dialogue_model_config_id,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,version}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-03') AS dialogue_model_config_version,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,node_bindings,0,effective_value,template_type}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-03') AS dialogue_template_type,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,node_bindings,0,effective_value,temperature}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-03') AS dialogue_temperature,
    (array_agg(payload #> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,effective_value,parameters_jsonb}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-03'))[1] AS dialogue_parameters,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,effective_value,model_name}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-05') AS commercial_model_name,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,effective_value,provider_base_url}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-05') AS commercial_provider_base_url,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,source_config_id}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-05') AS commercial_model_config_id,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,version}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-05') AS commercial_model_config_version,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,node_bindings,0,effective_value,template_type}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-05') AS commercial_template_type,
    max(payload #>> '{effective_config,node_bindings,0,effective_value,temperature}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-05') AS commercial_temperature,
    (array_agg(payload #> '{effective_config,model_templates,0,effective_value,parameters_jsonb}') FILTER (WHERE node_code='FP001-05'))[1] AS commercial_parameters
  FROM resolved
), skills AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'skill_id', s.skill_id,
    'version', s.version,
    'skill_name', s.skill_name,
    'skill_description', s.skill_description,
    'combo_logic', s.combo_logic,
    'constraint_fields', s.constraint_fields,
    'template_fields', s.template_fields
  ) ORDER BY s.skill_name, s.version), '[]'::jsonb) AS active_skills
  FROM public.skill AS s
  CROSS JOIN config AS c
  WHERE s.source_type='system_builtin'
    AND s.lifecycle_status='active'
    AND s.skill_category='题材组合'
    AND (s.genre_main->>'primary') = (c.form_data #>> '{intent_json,genre_main}')
), routed AS (
  SELECT c.*, skills.active_skills,
    CASE
      WHEN c.action='confirm_create' THEN 'confirm'
      WHEN c.action <> 'preview' THEN 'blocked'
      WHEN jsonb_array_length(skills.active_skills)=0 THEN 'blocked'
      WHEN c.config_available IS NOT TRUE THEN 'blocked'
      ELSE 'preview'
    END AS route,
    CASE
      WHEN c.action <> ALL (ARRAY['preview','confirm_create']) THEN 'INVALID_REQUEST'
      WHEN jsonb_array_length(skills.active_skills)=0 THEN 'ACTIVE_SKILL_UNAVAILABLE'
      ELSE 'ACTIVE_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE'
    END AS blocked_code
  FROM config AS c CROSS JOIN skills
)
SELECT
  route,
  form_data,
  creator_message,
  correlation_id,
  active_skills,
  dialogue_prompt,
  commercial_prompt,
  jsonb_build_object('model_name',dialogue_model_name,'provider_base_url',dialogue_provider_base_url,'source_config_id',dialogue_model_config_id,'version',dialogue_model_config_version,'template_type',dialogue_template_type,'temperature',dialogue_temperature::numeric,'parameters_jsonb',COALESCE(dialogue_parameters,'{}'::jsonb)) AS dialogue_model,
  jsonb_build_object('model_name',commercial_model_name,'provider_base_url',commercial_provider_base_url,'source_config_id',commercial_model_config_id,'version',commercial_model_config_version,'template_type',commercial_template_type,'temperature',commercial_temperature::numeric,'parameters_jsonb',COALESCE(commercial_parameters,'{}'::jsonb)) AS commercial_model,
  jsonb_build_object('form_snapshot',form_data,'creator_message',creator_message,'active_skills',active_skills) AS dialogue_input,
  jsonb_build_object('form_snapshot',form_data,'creator_message',creator_message) AS commercial_input,
  CASE WHEN route='blocked' THEN jsonb_build_object('status','BLOCKED','code',blocked_code,'message',CASE WHEN blocked_code='ACTIVE_SKILL_UNAVAILABLE' THEN 'The required active system skill is unavailable.' WHEN blocked_code='INVALID_REQUEST' THEN 'The request could not be accepted.' ELSE 'The preview dependencies are not available.' END,'correlation_id',correlation_id) END AS response
FROM routed;
